concept.title: The Person Missing From My Memories
concept.human_truth: The person absent from many photographs may be the person whose love, work, encouragement, joy, and freedom made those memories possible.
concept.emotional_arc: gallery imbalance -> absence questioned -> shared courage -> invisible creative support -> ordinary relief -> love without reduction -> authorship finally recognized
concept.visual_system: Storybook Gallery Portal: a present-day overhead gallery scene opens into complete illustrated memories that reveal what the cropped photograph left outside the frame

slides.copy: You’re missing from so many of my memories.
slides.visual: High true top-angle storybook view of Aachu and Zuv sitting shoulder-to-shoulder on a simple floor rug in their present-day shared space. A phone between them displays a restrained non-legible 3-by-4 photo grid: ten distinct thumbnails visibly show Aachu alone in different clothes and places; none visibly contains Zuv seated beside her. Aachu's scrolling finger stops and she turns from the phone to study Zuv's face while he still studies the grid. An open envelope nearby contains four small prints, each also showing Aachu alone. The phone remains a small physical object, never an enlarged interface. Keep both upper bodies and four owned hands readable, with generous clean upper-middle paper for exact text.
slides.pose: Relaxed seated overhead geometry, shoulders touching lightly, Aachu's index finger paused above the phone, Zuv's near hand resting open beside the phone; no embrace or staged romance pose.
slides.wardrobe: Present-day casual clothes anchored to the selected couple references: Aachu in a soft grey patterned kurta or relaxed grey layer; Zuv in a charcoal shirt and tan trousers.
slides.props: One phone with a believable but non-legible photo grid, one low cushion, one small open photo envelope kept secondary. No enlarged phone UI, floating images, scrapbook wall, laptop, or random text.
slides.background: Neutral warm-ivory paper, restrained lived floor texture, soft afternoon window light, minimal shared-space traces without decorative home clutter.
slides.continuity_lock: Slide 7 returns to this exact overhead location and wardrobe with warmer light. Exactly two people, one phone, four owned traceable hands, no reflections or background people.

slides.visual: Closer three-quarter overhead view in the same present-day space and wardrobe. Aachu taps one solo thumbnail of herself beside moving cartons. The selected image remains visible at the centre while its rectangular edge dissolves organically into a larger warm-watercolor apartment-doorway memory around the seated couple: two suitcases and Zuv entering with his own suitcase become visible outside the original phone-photo crop. Zuv leans closer in the present. The transition must feel like a storybook page revealing the complete lived scene, never a split screen, collage, portal graphic, floating gallery, or app mockup.
slides.pose: Aachu's tapping hand and both faces remain visible; Zuv leans closer with a subtle dawning expression. Hands stay separate from the dissolving memory elements.
slides.wardrobe: Same present-day wardrobe as slides 1 and 7.
slides.props: One phone with one selected photo; emerging memory contains two suitcases and one moving carton. No floating gallery cards, UI chrome, arrows, labels, or decorative photo frames.
slides.background: Present-day rug fades softly into the unfamiliar new-city apartment threshold; preserve ample text space above.
slides.continuity_lock: Exact same couple, phone, wardrobe, light direction, and seating as slide 1. The memory expansion sets up slide 3. Exactly two present-day people; any people inside the tiny phone image must not read as additional live actors.

slides.copy: You were there when I chose courage.
slides.visual: Full wide cinematic memory at the threshold of a modest unfamiliar apartment in a new city. Aachu stands just inside with new keys in her palm, excited and visibly uncertain. Half-open cartons and her suitcase locate the move. Behind her, Zuv enters carrying his own suitcase, not carrying hers: her courageous decision has changed both their lives and he has come along rather than merely helping her settle. She looks back to him; he gives a small grounded go-on expression; her key hand moves toward the lock. The door opening is the visible consequence.
slides.pose: Aachu foreground at the threshold, torso turned back toward Zuv; Zuv one step behind with his own suitcase. Maintain natural two-inch height difference and clear feet, hands, door plane, and luggage ownership.
slides.wardrobe: Moving-day clothes selected from identity references: Aachu in a simple red patterned sleeveless top with blue jeans; Zuv in a light zip top with grey trousers.
slides.props: Two distinct suitcases, one set of keys, three restrained moving cartons with no readable labels.
slides.background: New-city apartment corridor and nearly empty room, cool daylight becoming warmer inside, no neighbours, movers, reflections, skyline spectacle, or decorative home shorthand.
slides.continuity_lock: This is the complete memory selected on slide 2. Exactly two people. Zuv carries his own suitcase; the image must not imply he is only a porter or rescuer.

slides.copy: You made me visible from places no one could see.
slides.visual: A specific creative-work scene in a small improvised studio. Aachu works in the lit recording and creation area beside an unfinished illustrated page and notes. A small camera preview facing Zuv visibly frames only Aachu. Zuv stands outside that preview behind the camera and soft light, adjusts the light, watches her framing, and gives a restrained timing cue; Aachu looks toward him rather than directly into the lens. The full illustration contains both people while the recorded rectangle contains only her. Keep equipment sparse and make their shared labour legible without UI, social-media chrome, or a generic applause pose.
slides.pose: Aachu active in the lit foreground; Zuv offset in the deeper camera-light position, one hand adjusting the light stand and one hand giving a small timing cue. No applause, worship pose, or passive husband.
slides.wardrobe: Creative-work day: Aachu in a clean off-white shirt with blue jeans; Zuv in a dark navy or charcoal top with tan trousers, anchored to selected references.
slides.props: One camera on tripod, one soft light, one worktable, one unfinished illustrated page with no readable text, restrained notes and pencil. No monitor UI, social media interface, ring-light cliché, duplicated camera, or random typography.
slides.background: Modest real working corner with neutral walls and warm practical light; paper grain and soft watercolor edges remain visible.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Every stand and cable stays separate from bodies. The scene must read as shared creative labour, not generic filming equipment.

slides.copy: You held the world outside for a minute.
slides.visual: Late-night ordinary city pause after a difficult day. Their car is safely parked at a quiet broad roadside under warm streetlights. Aachu stands beside the passenger side folded with real laughter, fully turned toward Zuv. Several feet away Zuv makes a playful gesture while taking her photograph; a small natural camera preview contains Aachu laughing alone while the full illustration shows Zuv causing and recording the moment. Her closed work tote and face-down phone remain inside the open passenger door, physically outside this breathable minute. No food, chai, scenic overlook, grand date, traffic danger, or tourist landmark.
slides.pose: Aachu beside the passenger door mid-laugh, weight uneven and natural; Zuv at a safe distance with phone camera held in one hand and the other completing a playful gesture. No running in traffic, dancing pose, food, chai, scenic overlook, or grand date.
slides.wardrobe: After-work clothes anchored to references: Aachu in a relaxed grey layer over a light top; Zuv in a white or off-white zip top with dark trousers.
slides.props: One parked car, one phone in Zuv's hand, one closed work tote and Aachu's face-down phone visible through the open passenger door.
slides.background: Ordinary urban roadside with distant building windows and muted traffic glow, no brand signs, crowds, delivery riders, duplicate cars dominating the scene, or tourist landmark.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. The emotional action is Zuv creating the laugh and Aachu meeting his gaze; the camera is secondary evidence.

slides.copy: You never made love the reason I stayed behind.
slides.visual: Departure threshold outside their building at early morning, with a waiting cab safely pulled to the curb. Aachu faces the open rear door with one travel suitcase and backpack, leaving alone for an opportunity. Zuv stands behind and slightly to the side after tightening one loose backpack strap; his hand has already released it. Their hands separate in the lower centre while her feet and suitcase remain decisively oriented toward the cab. She looks back at him; he holds the sadness without blocking her path. The visible consequence is that the way forward stays open.
slides.pose: Aachu in forward motion toward the cab, torso turning back for one final gaze; Zuv stationary with open released hand, never gripping her, the bag, or the door. Natural height and clear spatial distance.
slides.wardrobe: Travel morning: Aachu in a light shirt, blue jeans and practical backpack; Zuv in a dark casual shirt and tan trousers.
slides.props: One suitcase, one backpack, one waiting cab with unreadable plate, one open rear door. No airport signage, train, waving crowd, tickets, text, or melodramatic luggage pile.
slides.background: Quiet residential street at dawn with cool light warming at the horizon; no driver, neighbours, reflections, extra silhouettes, or dramatic sunset.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. The scene must read as loving release, not abandonment or breakup. Aachu's path stays unobstructed and Zuv's hand is visibly released.

slides.copy: Sometimes the person missing from your memories is the person who made them possible.
slides.visual: Return to slide 1's exact true top-angle room, wardrobe, cushion, phone, and envelope, now slightly wider and warmer. The same ten solo thumbnails and four solo prints remain visible nearby. The phone is propped against the cushion facing outward with an unmistakable countdown light but no readable UI. Aachu pulls Zuv beside her into the new live camera composition; she looks at him and he looks back, surprised and warm, neither posing. For the first time the active camera frame visibly contains both people. Preserve generous clean upper 42 percent for the long exact text and keep the prints secondary, never a scrapbook collage.
slides.pose: Both seated close on the rug, bodies naturally angled toward each other rather than the phone; Aachu's near hand rests at Zuv's forearm, Zuv's hand supports them on the floor. Clear attached limbs and gentle two-inch height relationship.
slides.wardrobe: Exact present-day wardrobe from slides 1 and 2.
slides.props: One phone propped safely against one cushion, one open photo envelope, four small non-legible prints. No selfie stick, floating photos, UI enlargement, scrapbook wall, frame-within-frame, or confetti.
slides.background: Same restrained shared space as slide 1 with warmer late-afternoon light and neutral ivory paper.
slides.continuity_lock: Intentional match cut to slide 1. Exactly two people and one phone. Text is long: preserve generous clean upper 42% with no faces, hands, phone, prints, or high-contrast marks behind it.

copy.caption_recommended: I kept finding myself in the photographs. Then I started noticing everything outside the crop.
copy.caption_alt: Some people appear in every photograph. Some people are the reason the photographs exist.
